development_model_comparison.selection_scope: five engine-grouped folds on development engines only
development_model_comparison.ranking_rule: lowest motor-normalized NASA score, then lowest RMSE
development_model_comparison.champion_rule: XGBoost requires at least 5% lower development RMSE than Ridge without a worse motor-normalized NASA score

calibration.label: nominal empirical interval; not a safety guarantee

alert_rules.source: Recomputed from the byte-identical fd001-repro predictions; the 2026-07-29 lock already fixed the interval_low risk band source.
alert_rules.interval_method: two-sided Wilson 95% over one row per engine

boundaries: FD001 is a simulated benchmark, not operational fleet telemetry.
Official test labels were opened only after the model lock was written and validated.
Point-threshold critical metrics use prediction <= 30; interface risk bands use interval_low.
The public bundle contains aggregate evidence only; it does not redistribute NASA rows or model binaries.
FD001 protocol v2 test labels had been seen before v2 was designed; only the FD003 result is a clean single-open test of the frozen protocol.

fd001_seed_sweep.scope: Seeds vary cross-fit folds, model randomness, draws, and the final fit. Selection is not rerun, so spread excludes selection variance.
fd001_seed_sweep.note: The locked seed 42 has the lowest RMSE, MAE, and NASA score of the ten seeds.

fd001_challengers.scope: training engines only, run on fd001-v2-selection, which shares settings with fd001-v2

cqr.note: Quantile models reused a tree count tuned for squared error, so this bounded trial may underfit; it does not show that CQR is worse in general.

repeat_run.reason: Each different file carries the run ID or a hash of a file that does.

v1_lock_hash_difference.cause: The repro lock adds the environment field introduced by commit 1a13887 and has a different run_id.
v1_lock_hash_difference.verification: Removing environment from the repro lock and restoring the reference run_id reproduces the reference hash exactly, so all locked data, model, and artifact hashes match.

alert_rules.scope: one row per engine; intervals are two-sided Wilson 95%
